1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 b6 5.O-O.strategy: Castles at once: the king is safe and White needs no more than normal development to keep the pressure on Black's centre. Black's fianchetto has not yet taken a stand against the c4-d5 tension, so White can choose the moment to act.
1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 b6 5.O-O.name: King's Indian Attack: Yugoslav Variation
